name: @whz/sim
description: The simulation kernel: fixed integer ticks, commands in, events out, state in declared tables, one RNG stream per system, a canonical state digest, snapshots and replays.

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && eslint . && vitest run && npm run golden
scripts.golden: node src/node/cli.ts replay golden/counter-shop.replay.json && node src/node/cli.ts replay golden/counter-shop.replay.json --heavy
